name: CPU Volume Raycasting for Intersection
definition: A CPU-based raycasting algorithm that iterates through all VolumeRenderedObject instances in the scene to find the first intersection between a world-space ray and any volume dataset, returning the closest hit.
summary: CPU Volume Raycasting for Intersection performs voxel sampling and transfer function evaluation on the CPU to find the closest volume hit, differing from GPU methods and simple bounding-box tests.
